before.instruction: Prepare Stream A: on a 10 mL final-volume basis, charge DMAOL: 1.26 mmol (0.126 M final); N-diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol (DMAOL): 1.26 mmol (0.126 M final); add methanol to 10 mL total. Convert mmol to weighed/dispensed amount using the verified reagent MW, assay, and density recorded at preparation.
Prepare Stream B: connect H2 to the assigned MFC at 1.412 mL/min at STP on the declared STP basis (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar; 22.414 L/mol); no liquid stock is prepared.
Assemble only the inventory-assigned process graph and verify every equipment ID and connection against the final diagram.
Prime each liquid line with its declared solvent using its assigned pump until the outlet is bubble-free; do not introduce reactive feeds during priming.
Pressure-test with compatible inert fluid to the approved operating setpoint of 21 bar and verify stable pressure before reagents.
Purge the gas path with the inventory-declared nitrogen source, verify oxygen removal by the laboratory-approved method, then isolate nitrogen before hydrogen admission.
Verify the declared non-return/check valve is installed in the hydrogen feed in the correct flow direction.
Verify the gas-liquid separator off-gas is connected to the declared safe vent before hydrogen admission.
Confirm grounded ventilation is active and ignition sources are excluded.
Use the laboratory-approved PPE and containment for every declared reagent.
Define and rehearse the emergency feed-stop sequence.
Segregate and label all process and flush waste by hazard class.
Define blockage and overpressure response without opening a pressurized line.
Cool and depressurize through the controlled outlet before opening the system.
Stop hydrogen, purge residual gas, and depressurize in a defined sequence.
Start liquid feeds at the canonical setpoints. Admit gas only after liquid flow, temperature, pressure, purge, and vent checks are stable.

Allow an initial commissioning interval of at least 18 min, based on three nominal liquid-volume turnovers. Confirm steady outlet composition and stable flow, pressure and temperature before collection; elapsed time alone does not establish steady state. Measure phase holdup or tracer response when gas or a packed bed is present.

After measured steady state, collect a timed fraction over at least 6 min as an initial sampling interval; record exact start/end times and collected mass or volume. Extend collection if needed for the analytical method.

Collect the crude outlet in the assigned vessel and retain a labeled aliquot for conversion, selectivity, and yield analysis. This first screen ends at crude collection; no isolation work-up is authorized unless the chemist adds a confirmed downstream procedure to the intake package.
Stop reactive feeds, flush each compatible line, cool the reactor to a safe handling temperature, and isolate energy sources.

before.label: T-mixer | Hydrogen-service T-mixer
before.rationale: From Chemistry Plan: H2 gas (stream B) introduced into DMAOL/methanol liquid stream (stream A) at mixer_h2_t (SS T-mixer, max 40 bar) immediately upstream of reactor_h2_pbr_300 packed bed. BPR bpr_h2_21 downstream of packed bed and gas-liquid separator maintains 21 bar system pressure.
